_about: Manuka Oval (Canberra) as it is in 2026, for build.py. Frame: x east, y north from the OSM pitch way 4941717's node centroid (lat -35.3180995, lon 149.1345344); the field centre is C. Bearings are compass degrees from C; d is metres past the fence (the OSM pitch outline); z is metres above the field. Plan read off aerial imagery (Esri World Imagery, unwrapped round the fence) and OSM; heights and rows by eye from Google Earth 3D (2026-11-22). Looks only.

lower._: the low front terrace all round: light grey seats, 8 rows to the concourse

astands._: the stands under thin dark roofs with white A-frames on top: rows of mixed-colour seats

bradman._: Bradman Stand: 5 front rows, a plinth wall, 16 rows to the boxes under a deep white roof (OSM way 122524193)

red._: the open red-seat terraces on the east side: three blocks with stairs between

hill._: the east bank: grass slope, path, gravel terrace, box hedge on top

media._: the media and corporate building over the southern seats (in OSM's Menzies Terrace): curved, four levels of bronze fins, a white curved roof

screen._: the video screen on a steel frame, north-east

scoreboard._: Jack Fingleton Scoreboard (OSM way 1290130248), heritage, from the MCG

nest._: camera box on a tapered column behind the north stand's east end

towers._: six 47 m light towers (2013), leaning in so no part tops Parliament House's height rule; OSM masts

residence._: the 1930s curator's residence, two storeys, cream render, terracotta hipped roof
